prompt: Generate a multi-view design proposal for women's lingerie with a single diagonal flowing composition, fully presenting a set of terracotta copper and deep chocolate front-buckle halter lingerie. Features: soft-wired half-cup bra with micro-arched cups, bias-cut terracotta copper satin panels, deep chocolate stretch mesh side panels, adjustable halter straps, a bronze-colored rotating buckle at the front center, narrow underband, and low-back structure; paired with low-rise Brazilian panties with an asymmetrical diagonal front, thin side straps, and scalloped back. Abstract lava flow-line embroidery passes from one side of the bra cup through the underband and forms a corresponding curve on the opposite side of the panties. A stepped editorial composition extends from top-left to bottom-right. The largest module in the top-left (approx. 38% of the frame) presents the main product visual on a terracotta metal surface. A large vertical center module shows the fit on a 21-year-old adult female model, slightly turning to show the halter straps and low-back silhouette with a mature, sharp demeanor. Diagonal modules include front/back structure views, flat-lay view, macro shots of embroidery and buckles, and material boards for the satin and mesh. All modules are connected by light/dark copper color blocks and thin arcs, sharing consistent design elements and a warm side-lit evening wear photography texture.

promptZh: 生成一份女性内衣的多视角设计提案，采用单一对角线流动构图，完整呈现一套 赤陶铜色与深巧克力色 前扣式挂脖内衣。产品特色：软钢圈半杯文胸，配有微拱形罩杯、斜裁赤陶铜色缎面拼接、深巧克力色弹力网眼侧翼、可调节挂脖肩带、前中心青铜色旋转扣、窄底围及低背结构；搭配低腰巴西式内裤，前片呈不对称斜线剪裁，配有细侧带及扇形后摆。抽象的熔岩流线型刺绣从文胸一侧罩杯延伸至底围，并在内裤对侧形成呼应的曲线。采用从左上角延伸至右下角的阶梯式编辑构图。左上角最大的模块（约占画面 38%）在赤陶金属表面展示产品主视觉。大型垂直中心模块展示 21 岁 成年女性模特上身效果，模特微微转动以展示挂脖肩带和低背轮廓，展现成熟、干练的气质。对角线模块包含正/背面结构视图、平铺视图、刺绣与扣件的微距镜头，以及缎面与网眼的材质项目。所有模块通过浅色/深色铜色色块和细弧线连接，共享统一的设计元素，并呈现出温暖的侧光晚装摄影质感。
